blocks.x: Cyber & Zero-Trust for Payments & Cards — zero-trust by architecture, not by slide — identity, detection, resilience and ai security in one program applied to the payments & cards operating unit of Banking & Financial Services.

Payments is a real-time decision business wearing a compliance uniform: instant rails compress fraud windows to seconds, authorization economics reward millisecond latency, and every innovation (click-to-pay, tokenized wallets) inherits the same decision spine.

items: Continuous-compliance expectations replace annual snapshots; tokenization and segmentation evidence is assembled manually.
Fraud and risk enrichment adds milliseconds that cost approval rates; batch components cannot sit on the instant path.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Cyber Resilience & Incident Recovery, Compliance, Audit & Digital Trust, Cloud Security & Posture Management from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Authorization decisioning, Chargeback/dispute handling, Scheme settlement reconciliation) on Tele Medicine Platform and Driisti Smart Vision Glasses. Governance inherits the sector frame — PCI DSS 4.0 among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Identity as the perimeter — workforce, customer and machine identities on one governed plane.
Secure at the control plane — posture, workload and data security engineered into the platform.
Secure the models themselves — prompt-injection defense, agent containment and AI red-teaming.
tokenization, segmentation and continuous evidence (audit prep automated)

blocks.caption: Regimes shaping this capability
rows: cardholder-data estate compliance with continuous expectations
ICT risk, incident reporting, resilience testing and third-party oversight obligations with supervisory scrutiny
